title: Fix parsing cpu.max file in cgroup v2 implementation

timeline.message: Fix parsing cpu.max file in cgroup v2 implementation
timeline.author: Alessandro Patti

timeline.body:
Instead of changing the content here, would you please add a new test with this test case? (I assume both cases can happen)

Maybe we can name the new test as `fileWithLineBreak_ setCpuLimit_v2()`.

reply.body: Done! TBH, I don't think both formats are possible, probably the newline is always present, but testing both does not harm

timeline.body: Ditto. Adding a test case would be great here!
Would you please move the `max 1000` case to a separate test?

reply.body: Can you also help us fix the naming here? I suppose the variable name should be `cpu` instead of `memory`.

timeline.body: Thanks for the fix! I've left a few comments.

timeline.author: Alessandro Patti
